// Tiles a planar shape on a lattice with the given period per axis. Counts
// bounds the repetitions per axis; a non-positive count means unbounded
// repetition along that axis.
type SdfRepetitionModifier2D
    implements IValue
{
    Period: Vector2D;
    Counts: IntegerVector2;
}
